The NetBeansFX Content API provides neutral content identity, classification and the persisted-state vocabulary shared by docking, drop handlers and content stores. It lets a product name content, classify it by an extensible kind and capture the opaque state needed to recreate it, without exposing any editor or window implementation type.
Identities use the single namespaced {@code namespace:name} form shared by the other nbfx typed ids. Kinds are extensible: neutral built-ins exist for editor, view, output, terminal and canvas content, and products define their own kinds. State records defensively copy their payloads. This slice contains no JavaFX type, no content factory and no manager; the content lifecycle contracts land in the following slices of the same domain.
Neutral content identity, classification and persisted-state vocabulary. This API remains devel until the CJAP reference product and scenarios pass.
Name content with a stable, namespaced identity.
Classify content by a neutral or product-defined kind.
Capture and restore the opaque state of one content instance without interpreting it.
Unit tests cover id parsing and rejection, built-in and custom kind resolution, payload immutability and instance-key validation.
A JDK is required only to compile.
